parsed.title: Daily News Reader Streak
parsed.oneLiner: Turn daily news reading into rewards with a streak tracker and Reader Points redeemable for ad-free time and saved articles.

newMechanic.name: Reader Loyalty Program
newMechanic.description: Daily reading streak tracking and rewarded point collection backed by the signed-in AOL account cloud database for cross-session persistence.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: News apps lack inherent scarcity; this creates a habit loop for daily retention and unlocks rewarded ad inventory that complements organic reading while offering tangible utility like ad-free browsing hours.

parsed.trigger: Proactive entry via the daily streak badge on the News Feed Home screen.

offer.title: Earn Reader Points
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with AOL to earn 50 Reader Points. Redeem points for an ad-free browsing hour or extra saved article capacity.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: ReaderPoints are earned through attention and redeemed for utility like ad-free time or saved article capacity rather than direct cash, preserving IAP while leveraging cloud-synced account state.
risks: Users may ignore tasks if point redemption thresholds are set too high.
Cloud sync latency for streak persistence across devices.
